brief:
Israel's attorney general on Tuesday called on the intelligence agency Shin Bet to share its findings from an investigation into electoral fraud allegations involving Palestinian citizens, Middle East Eye reported. The attorney general's request came as the intelligence service examines claims of voting irregularities.

The move marks an effort to obtain concrete evidence from Shin Bet's probe into the alleged fraud.
